name: OpenFEMA API
known_limitations: OpenFEMA datasets have program-specific definitions, declaration and award stages, geographic scope, reporting lags, revisions, and missingness; records do not prove all losses or recovery outcomes.
automation_notes: Select one dataset and preserve schema version, program, declaration, geography, date, amount, status, reporting lag, and revision fields.
notes: Machine-readable rail for disaster declarations, assistance, mitigation, grants, and related program records.
